dunning_kruger_effect.definition: The pattern in which people with little skill in a domain overestimate their ability, because the skill needed to judge answers is the same skill needed to give them.

thank_you.definition: The polite word you say after somebody helps you or gives you something.
thank_you.example: Thank you for lending me your ruler.

transferable_skill.definition: An ability that counts in a new job even when the industry or the title is different.
transferable_skill.example: Project coordination is a transferable skill, whatever the sector.
